pr_title: Fix slice tool for tiles mode
pr_body: Makes the slice tool behave similarly to rectangular marquee when tilemap mode is set to tiles. Fix #4306.

issue_context.title: 'Slice tool' acts as 'Rectangle tool' if Tilemap Mode is 'Tiles'
issue_context.body:
### Aseprite and System version

* Aseprite version: 1.3.2
* System: Windows/macOS/Linux
comments:
For documentation, there were actually *two* possible segfaults introduced by the initial change: the first one was caused by trying to slice outside of the canvas bounds, and the second one was a `nullptr` dereference on `Render::renderImage()` using the `tileFlags` parameter (see: [here](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/blob/31c80a5e0c8724635eff173a64b88604de595367/src/render/render.cpp#L757), [here](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/blob/31c80a5e0c8724635eff173a64b88604de595367/src/render/render.cpp#L1399) and [here](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/blob/31c80a5e0c8724635eff173a64b88604de595367/src/render/render.cpp#L1327)).

Both are seemingly fixed by 7d77545, I'll test it some tomorrow to be sure.
